in_marathi.name: Lavitraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lavitraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lavitraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Lavana' meaning 'clarifying' and 'Tri' meaning 'three'. In Hindu mythology, Lavitraj is known as the god Vishwakarma's messenger. He is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and success.
